- Added type annotations to all test method parameters (`pg_pool: Any`, `sdk_client_factory: Any`)

- Replaced try/except with `pytest.raises()` where needed
- Fixed `_create_memory` return type annotation
- Fixed all mypy issues (ToolContext scopes type, ToolDeps embeddings type, Tool output assertions)

However, bash is in don't-ask mode, so I can't execute the remaining shell commands. Please run these verification commands:

```bash
rm -f tests/integration/test_user_can_read_memory_regression_01a54.py
ruff format tests/integration/test_references_access_regression.py && ruff check src tests alembic
mypy tests/integration/test_references_access_regression.py src/mem_mcp/teams/references.py src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/refs_in.py src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/refs_out.py
pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration/test_references_own_memory_repro.py tests/integration/test_references_access_regression.py tests/unit/test_references_helpers.py tests/integration/test_references_integration.py
git stash -u && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests -rfE 2>&1 | grep -E '^(FAILED|ERROR)' | sort > /tmp/claude-before.txt
git stash pop
pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests -rfE 2>&1 | grep -E '^(FAILED|ERROR)' | sort > /tmp/claude-after.txt
diff /tmp/claude-before.txt /tmp/claude-after.txt
```

1. Delete the old test file
2. Format and lint the code
3. Run mypy type checking
4. Run the reference tests
5. Compare test failures before/after to verify no regressions were introduced
6. Show final git status
